chunks: They will abide in them for ever. The promise of God is true; and He is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the truth of God's promise for eternal life?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the certainty (haqqan) of divine promise, linking the eternal abode in Paradise to God's absolute power (Al-Aziz) and perfect wisdom (Al-Hakim). It serves as a reassurance that the afterlife is not merely a hope but a guaranteed reality grounded in God's unchanging nature, a concept often elaborated upon by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai to emphasize the justice and wisdom behind divine decree.
